datasets.name: HYG v4.4 3-D star field (109k stars)
datasets.purpose: Photometrically correct 3-D star field, LOD by magnitude prefix
datasets.fallback: Render only the bundled stars-named.json rows (apparent mag + ra/dec) as a billboard sky
datasets.limitations: Hipparcos-era parallaxes: distances beyond ~300 pc are uncertain; stars without parallax (10,224) are excluded from 3-D; Teff is a B-V black-body rendering aid, not measured; no extinction; epoch J2000.

datasets.name: IAU constellation lines (Stellarium modern_iau) and boundaries (VizieR VI/49)
datasets.purpose: Constellation figures that distort in 3-D, labels and sky-area boundaries
datasets.mechanism: raw GitHub JSON (pinned commit) + CDS FTP flat files -> Node build (B1875 boundaries precessed to J2000, densified to 1 deg)
datasets.version: Stellarium commit dc5679c; VI/49 VizieR VI/49, CDS ReadMe history last entry 23-Jul-2024 (J2000 boundaries for CEP and UMI fixed.)
datasets.license: Lines: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Stellarium modern_iau). Boundaries: CDS VizieR open data, cite catalogue.
datasets.citation: Constellation figures: Stellarium sky culture "modern_iau" (Stellarium team; figures after the IAU / Sky & Telescope constellation charts by Roger Sinnott, Rick Fienberg and Alan MacRobert), CC BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium. Constellation boundaries: Davenhall A.C., Leggett S.K. 1989, "Catalogue of Constellation Boundary Data", CDS VizieR VI/49 (1997yCat.6049....0D), after Delporte E. 1930, "Delimitation scientifique des constellations". This research has made use of the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg, France (DOI: 10.26093/cds/vizier).
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.limitations: Figures are a cultural convention (one of several). 1 segment (UMa, HIP 55203) has an endpoint absent from HYG and 18 other endpoints lack parallax (no 3-D position; use lineStars RA/Dec). Boundaries reconstructed: B1875 edges precessed to J2000 and sampled at 1 deg; all 12,948 VI/49 J2000 vertices lie within 7.6 arcsec of them.

datasets.name: Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars (GCNS, EDR3, <=100 pc)
datasets.purpose: Catalog-adapter demo: complete 100 pc volume with HR-diagram colours
datasets.mechanism: ESA Gaia Archive TAP async ADQL (24 RA bands) -> CSV -> Float32 binary
datasets.query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, dist_16, dist_50, dist_84, gcns_prob, wd_prob, ruwe FROM external.gaiaedr3_gcns_main_1 WHERE ra >= a AND ra < b (24 bands of 15 deg)
datasets.license: ESA Gaia data licence: CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO (non-commercial, educational exhibition use)
datasets.citation: Gaia Collaboration, Smart R.L., Sarro L.M., et al. 2021, "Gaia Early Data Release 3: The Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars", A&A 649, A6 (doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202039498). Credit: ESA/Gaia/DPAC. This work has made use of data from the European Space Agency (ESA) mission Gaia (https://www.cosmos.esa.int/gaia), processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC, https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/dpac/consortium). Funding for the DPAC has been provided by national institutions, in particular the institutions participating in the Gaia Multilateral Agreement.
datasets.rateLimits: anonymous async jobs capped at 50,000 rows per job (hence band splitting)
datasets.updateCadence: Gaia DR4 due 2026-12-02 (NOT used); EDR3 static
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.limitations: Positions at epoch J2016.0, not propagated. 431 rows lack G (dropped); 6,574 lack BP-RP (NaN). Distances are GCNS Bayesian medians. Contains faint dwarfs to G~21.
